# Tabs

Switch between peer panels while coordinating focus and activation.

## Usage

### Manual

Move focus between tabs without activating a panel until selection is confirmed.

<ComponentExample component="tabs" scenario="manual" title="Manual" description="Move focus between tabs without activating a panel until selection is confirmed." :index="0" />

### Automatic

Advance automatically while still exposing pause and direct navigation controls.

<ComponentExample component="tabs" scenario="automatic" title="Automatic" description="Advance automatically while still exposing pause and direct navigation controls." :index="1" />

### Vertical disabled

Move vertically through actions while skipping an unavailable item.

<ComponentExample component="tabs" scenario="vertical-disabled" title="Vertical disabled" description="Move vertically through actions while skipping an unavailable item." :index="2" />

## Selection-indicator motion example

The selected trigger exposes `aria-selected="true"`. A pseudo-element can emphasize the current tab or step without adding another interactive element.

```css
[data-scope='tabs'][data-part='trigger'] {
  position: relative;
}

[data-scope='tabs'][data-part='trigger']::after {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  inset-block-end: 0;
  block-size: 2px;
  content: '';
  background: currentColor;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transition: transform 160ms ease;
}

[data-scope='tabs'][data-part='trigger'][aria-selected='true']::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-scope='tabs'][data-part='trigger']::after {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

The tab list connects every tab to one tab panel and preserves selected, disabled, and orientation state.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/) for the host accessibility contract.
